success.description: 4 Bolts of scintillating flame lance from your outstretched hand or staff, striking your target for 6+Int damage, ignoring the soak value of the target’s armour.

conservative.requirements: 8 power. Target within medium range. If you are engaged with an enemy, add {Dc} to your dice pool. Special: If KO with this you an enemy spell, you may strike an additional enemy in the same engagement for the same effect. You may do this only once.

success.description: Bolts of scintillating flame lance from hand your outstretched or staff, striking your target for 7+Int damage.

boon.description: Ignore the soak value of the target’s armour.

sigmarsComet.description: The target suffers 1 critical wound, then suffers additional wounds equal to the severity of that critical wound.

reckless.requirements: 8 power. Target within medium range. If you are engaged with an enemy, add {Dm} to your dice pool. Special: If KO with this you an enemy spell, you may strike an additional enemy in the same engagement for the same effect but -2 damage; you may keep doing this (taking -2 damage each time) until you fail to KO an enemy or there are no enemies remaining in the engagement.
